rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides direct access to the vLEI.wiki knowledge base containing 420+ KERI (Key Event Receipt Infrastructure) and vLEI (verifiable Legal Entity Identifier) concepts from 3,588+ source documents. Built by Key State Capital, it offers specialized tools for searching KERI documentation with fuzzy matching, explaining complex cryptographic concepts with depth control, retrieving complete documents for analysis, accessing official GLEIF training context, and generating concept relationship graphs for visualization. The implementation transforms AI development environments into KERI/vLEI experts by enabling seamless integration with Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, and other MCP-compatible tools, making it particularly valuable for developers working with digital identity systems, cryptographic autonomy, or verifiable credential ecosystems.
